explanation: The extract_lab_csv adapter opens and parses laboratory CSV records using DictReader, validating fields such as patient reference UUIDs, timestamp strings, LOINC codes, and result values. Non-valid records trigger log calls containing only row numbers and parameter names before skipping to the next row. Valid records are transformed into standard FHIR Observation dictionaries with unique LAB row IDs.
suggested_tests: Verify successful transformation of valid CSV lab result records into FHIR Observation resources.
Verify rejection and correct log message formatting when result_value is non-numeric or missing.
Verify rejection when collected_at timestamp does not follow the required DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm format.
